authoritative_records.name: DevicePartUnit
authoritative_records.owns: operational service/fault component identity under Device Reference context, including slot/BOM/serial/condition/fault evidence where known; it may remain valid without registered Infrastructure

authoritative_records.name: SpareNeed
authoritative_records.owns: SR-level BOM demand, planned quantity and contributor relationships

authoritative_records.name: SpareRequest
authoritative_records.owns: local request identity, Need allocations, requested logistics and submission lifecycle

authoritative_records.name: RMA
authoritative_records.owns: official C10 obligation identity, promised BOM, target assignment and current return obligation

authoritative_records.name: InventoryPhysicalConsequence
authoritative_records.owns: accepted installation/removal/unused/faulty/incompatible/dismantled physical consequence tied to an already reviewed Task outcome

authoritative_records.name: ActualLogisticsEvent
authoritative_records.owns: actual dispatch/pickup/delivery/receipt/custody occurrence with independently addressable participants

authoritative_records.name: FaultTag
authoritative_records.owns: return-attempt identity, return method, submitted membership set, typed correction/replacement/resend lineage

authoritative_records.name: FaultTagMembership
authoritative_records.owns: one open RMA obligation + one selected physical return unit and its warehouse progression

authoritative_records.name: InventoryLifecycleEvent
authoritative_records.owns: append-oriented accepted Inventory transition/correction facts used to rebuild current projections

identity_rules: SR7/C10/BOM/serial/tracking labels are business/display evidence, never relational identity.
Official identifier correction preserves prior value as alias and does not replace internal identity.
One RMA has at most one direct inbound Spare Part Unit; dismantled extracted units get independent identities while preserving origin provenance.
One active submitted Fault Tag membership may own a given open RMA return obligation/physical return unit at a time.
Equal BOM/serial/official identifiers create reconciliation candidates only and never authorize silent merge.

When a Device Part Unit corresponds to a registered HLD-09 Installed Component, an explicit resolution relation may link the two immutable identities; neither identity replaces, merges, or silently becomes the other.
projection_rules: Stock is derived from Spare Part Unit condition/location/reservation/compatibility/disposition.
Current RMA/Spare Request/Fault Tag states derive from accepted append-oriented lifecycle evidence.
Current ticket/Device context for Fault Tag membership is derived through existing relationships, not copied as competing truth.
Registered Infrastructure component master/history is consumed through the optional DevicePartUnit-to-InstalledComponent resolution and remains HLD-09 authority.
